# Farmacia San Roque

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pharmacy and perfumery in Uruguay with an online store. Sells perfumes, makeup, skincare, personal care, health products, baby products, home cleaning and food. States shipping across Uruguay, with home delivery to the interior in about five business days and express delivery in two hours in covered areas.

*ES:* Farmacia y perfumería de Uruguay con tienda online. Vende perfumes, maquillaje, cuidado de la piel, cuidado personal, salud, bebés, limpieza del hogar y alimentos. Indica envíos a todo el país, con entrega al interior en unos cinco días hábiles y entrega exprés en dos horas en zonas cubiertas.
